Present application has been filed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure by the original accused for quashment of the First Information Report vide CR No. 441 of 2024 registered with with Sitabuldi Police Station, Nagpur against the applicant for the offence punishable under Sections, 376(2)(n), 323, 504 and 506 of Indian Penal Code 2.
Learned Additional Public Prosecutor waives notice for the non-applicant no.1.
It appears that the learned advocate for the applicant had privately issued notice to the non-applicant no.2 in SKNair 2 16-apl-989-24.odt advance.
Thereupon, the non-applicant no.2 has appeared before this Court along with her advocate and filed affidavit.

3. The non-applicant no.2 states that there was relationship between herself and applicant and it was consensual and without in force coercive but due to some misunderstanding she lodged the First Information Report.
Later on she had realized the misunderstanding and she states that she did not want to proceed with the complaint.

sentences.text: 1 4. Before we take the decision in the matter, we would like to observe that the informant appears to be around 30 years when she lodged the First Information Report.
She had made pinpointing allegation against the appellant.

They were worded as if the relationship or the sexual enactments were forcible in nature and therefore upon the said oral information which was then reduced into writing in the form of First Information Report under Section 154 of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
The cognizable offences were transferring and therefore the offences were registered.
Now, she is coming with a case that it was due to misunderstanding but the relationship was consensual.
She should have understood the consequences of her act when she lodged the First Information Report.
Lodging of the first information report which is false, is also in fact a punishable offence.
Now, it can be stated that it was given under some misunderstanding.

The purpose appears to be different behind the lodging of the First Information Report and therefore we SKNair 3 16-apl-989-24.odt deprecate such practice of lodging the First Information Report just to bring a person to the terms.

5. We would refrain ourselves from making any comments in respect of the First Information Report but as aforesaid when it is now transferring that though the informant was whereabout the nature of her relationship with the applicant as a consensual and it was without any force of coercion but she lodged the First Information Report for obvious reason, we take it exception to impose costs on her also.

We see no reason to continue the prosecution of the applicant in view of the said affidavit filed on behalf of the non-applicant no.2 and therefore by imposing costs on both, we allowed the application.
Accordingly, we proceed to pass the following order.

i. The First Information Report vide Crime No. 441 of 2024 dated 21st May, 2024 registered with Sitabuldi Police Station, Nagpur against the applicant Imran Sharif Shaikh for the offence punishable under Sections, 376(2)(n), 323, 504 and 506 of Indian Penal Code ii. The applicant to deposit costs of Rs.30,000/- as well as informant to deposit the costs of Rs.10,000/- respectively to the High Court Legal Services Sub-Committee, Nagpur within a period of 15 days from today.
